jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for Mochi Mayhem boss combat. Cute confectionery fantasy, 3/4 top-down, hand-painted soft candy/stone shading, clean mobile-readable effect silhouettes, restrained warm ivory/cream and neutral gray ONLY so future code can tint per boss. Match existing boss VFX references in painted finish, NOT their exact subject or grid. PURE SOLID OPAQUE BLACK #000000 background across every empty area and all gutters. No colored matte, no gray haze outside effect, no ground scenery, NO text/letters/numbers/logo/watermark/border/dividers. Fixed center/pivot and consistent camera/scale across frames; all particles safely inside cells with15percent black margins. Each frame is a different chronological animation phase, not identical copies. No body/hero/boss character drawing. No pastel pink/lilac collectible colors or rainbow sparkles. EXACTLY SIX square frames in THREE columns by TWO rows, whole canvas3:2. Read row-major. One ground CRACK SHOCKWAVE, centered at same point every frame; very flat ground ellipse width80percent cell, height48percent cell. Phase1 tiny impact crack, phase2 cracks open into small ring with a few sugar-stone crumbs, phase3 wider fractured ring and little pale crumbs jumping, phase4 broad ring with radiating ivory fissures, phase5 crumbling fading broken ring, phase6 almost gone few small faint crumbs. Hard visible fracture rim and restrained luminous cream edges, black ground interior open; no mound or permanent terrain chunk. Cracks remain within ring footprint, suitable to repeat these rings along a line. Only this six-phase ground rupture effect.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated painted ENEMY BOSS PROJECTILE, single frame, target128x128, true transparent RGBA background. NOT an icon badge, not a loot pickup, not a sheet. Cute confectionery fantasy combat matching legacy Mochi Mayhem boss effects: soft hand-painted shading, slightly top-down3/4, simple strong silhouette, BRIGHT IVORY/CREAM inner energy core and a substantial very DARK color-matched outline band (about6percent projectile width) so it reads on light and dark floors at60px. Main projectile points/travels RIGHT: front/nose/longest leading point on right, short trailing shape only on left. Centered compact body fits inside central82percent of square, complete empty transparent border; any trail stays short and inside safe margin. No external white glow cloud, ground shadow, scenery, letters/numbers/symbol labels/frame/watermark. Friendly but clearly dangerous enemy shot, not frightening, no blood/gore. Do NOT resemble EXP drops or Sugar: no pale lilac crystal, no bubblegum-pink candy, no wrappers, collectible orbit rings, rainbow facets or circular item medallion. Preserve directional silhouette and dark boundary rather than a plain glowing orb. Subject: One LIME-GREEN ACID TEARDROP, fat rear on left, clear sharp fluid nose right. Chartreuse/yellow-green body, bright cream core and deep olive edge. A little trailing acid flick left, not a gem.
